meta.title: Starting a Clothing Brand with No Experience or Connections.
meta.description:
The rumors I've been telling are true! You should subscribe and follow me on Instagram too @8thWeekday 
 
UH OH I'm starting a clothing brand/line in 2021! What could go wrong besides everything! Like I was saying it's focused around raw, Japanese, selvedge denim BUT eventually I'm hoping to make it a full on smack you in the face brand so...I'm thrilled. Figured I'd vlog the entire thing so that way Other people can try and do it too...or idk just for fun. What could go wrong? Maybe Levi's will sue me idk but I was planning on calling everything 501's. That's not what I'm the most nervous about but I will say that is something I've thought of.

THE IRON SNAIL THE CLOTHING LINE LAUNCHING SOON NEAR YOU

#theironsnail

The Iron Snail is a men’s fashion vlog starring a young man named Michael and featuring a snail no bigger than a quarter. The two are set on taking over the world of fashion by creating a clothing line to end all clothing lines. Until then, we’re here to tell you EVERYTHING you need to know about the best clothing out there, from the highest quality raw denim jeans to the warmest jacket to the sturdiest boots…the Iron Snail has got you covered. (written by Taylor, though Michael is sometimes known to talk about himself in the third person… xoxo)
